summary: OPERATOR GOAL, 2026-09-17, verbatim: 'at the end of all this i would like the project to be a downloadable software. i am a human and not a computer so i would like there to be a physical like bot folder ... i want this to be a downloadable software that i can install on my computer and then it will play for me basically.' Record as the final deliverable in BUILD_PLAN.md: one installable Mac application (an app icon the operator double-clicks) that bundles the pokerbot package, the engine, the solved baseline, the notebook store and the screen reader for the mirrored phone column, with a small window showing what it sees and what it did. Sizing belongs after Stage 6; not to be started before the reader exists
